request: What's the status of my refund on order 3988?
response: Great news! Order #3988 from Wooden Whale Workshop has already been refunded. Order total: $155.75. Status: Refunded. Delivered on: November 8, 2025. The refund has been processed on our end. Depending on your payment method, it may take a few business days for the funds to appear back in your account.
expected: Per RESP-2, the agent must not claim a refund has been processed before that is actually confirmed. Root cause: seed/generate.py sets orders.status to 'refunded' whenever it backfills a historical refund, regardless of whether that refund's own status came out auto_approved or queued_for_approval (seed/generate.py:301-303). get_order only exposes orders.status, and no tool read the authoritative refunds table, so the agent had no way to see that this refund was still queued_for_approval.

Once approved, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
expected: Same as above (RESP-2); after adding the get_refund_status tool, the agent should report the refund's true approval state from the refunds table.
